description: This file defines the AppEnv class, which encapsulates environment variables related to API and WebSocket URLs for a Flutter application. It provides a method to instantiate the environment from a .env file using the flutter_dotenv package.

classes.name: AppEnv
classes.description: Represents the application's environment configuration with API and WebSocket URLs, loaded from environment variables.

methods.name: fromEnv
methods.description: Creates an AppEnv instance by reading environment variables 'API_BASE_URL' and 'WS_URL' from the .env file.
